summary: Investigated the subagents gizmo extension: located the gizmo-registry repo under ~/.gizmo/registries/, ran its type check and 158 tests (all passing), verified the server-side integration loads cleanly (~2.1s, valid list/invoke), and probed the live WebSocket to confirm subagents is present in the agent-server extension descriptors. Then began checking why the web side never activates it, inspecting the integration resolver, web bundle loader diagnostics, and protocol version (27).
decisions: Approach the issue as runtime, not build, since pnpm check and pnpm test both pass in the gizmo-registry repo (46 files, 158 tests).
Probe the running agent-server via WebSocket from the browser instead of just reading source, to compare server-side vs web-side activation.
errors: esbuild TransformError when loading one extension index.ts under apps/agent-server with tsx; worked around by renaming to .mts, after which both subagents and workflows imported successfully and returned valid gizmoExtension objects.
